entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know we still haven't[n]touched that request from[n]Mishima, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We still haven't decided[n]on our next big target.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wanna just go take care of it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh yeah, we still haven't finished[n]Mishima's request.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we're going to Mementos, do you[n]want to have everyone gather at the[n]hideout?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: OK! Let's meet up[n]at the hideout then.
